arxiv-2102-00026.title: Decay in norm of transfer operators for semiflows
arxiv-2102-00026.creator: Ian Melbourne, Nicolò Paviato, Dalia Terhesiu
arxiv-2102-00026.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ian Melbourne, Nicolò Paviato, Dalia Terhesiu. We establish exponential decay in Hölder norm of transfer operators applied to smooth observables of uniformly and nonuniformly expanding semiflows with exponential decay of correlations. 1 Introduction Exponential decay of correlations is well-understood for large classes of uniformly and nonuniformly expanding maps, see for example [ 8 , 11 , 13 , 14 , 16 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 26 ] .

arxiv-2107-00944.title: The Poisson enveloping algebra and the algebra of Poisson differential operators of a generalized Weyl Poisson algebra
arxiv-2107-00944.creator: V. V. Bavula
arxiv-2107-00944.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V. V. Bavula. For a generalized Weyl Poisson algebra A A , explicit sets of generators and defining relations are presented for its Poisson enveloping algebra 𝒰 ⁡ ( A ) {\cal U}(A) . Simplicity criteria are given for the algebra 𝒰 ⁡ ( A ) {\cal U}(A) and algebra of Poisson differential operators P ​ 𝒟 ​ ( A ) P{\cal D}(A) on A A .

arxiv-2109-04689.title: Generating Self-Contained and Summary-Centric Question Answer Pairs via Differentiable Reward Imitation Learning
arxiv-2109-04689.creator: Li Zhou, Kevin Small, Yong Zhang, Sandeep Atluri
arxiv-2109-04689.description: Abstract Motivated by suggested question generation in conversational news recommendation systems, we propose a model for generating question-answer pairs (QA pairs) with self-contained, summary-centric questions and length-constrained, article-summarizing answers. We begin by collecting a new dataset of news articles with questions as titles and pairing them with summaries of varying length.

arxiv-2306-10487.title: Dynamical Analysis of the Dirac-Born-Infeld type of Tachyon field minimally coupled with barotropic fluid using EOS parametrization of a field
arxiv-2306-10487.creator: Saddam Hussain, Saikat Chakraborty, Nandan Roy, Kaushik Bhattacharya
arxiv-2306-10487.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Saddam Hussain, Saikat Chakraborty, Nandan Roy, Kaushik Bhattacharya. In this paper, we present a dynamical system analysis of the tachyon dark energy model by parametrization of the equation of state (EoS) of the dark energy. The choice of parametrization can constrain the form of the field potential, and as a result, the theory can be directly constrained from the observation without assuming a particular form of the potential.

arxiv-2307-11658.title: About the Blaschke-Santaló diagram of area, perimeter and moment of inertia Thanks: Acknowledgments. This work was supported by the project ANR-18-CE40-0013 SHAPO financed by the French Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR)
arxiv-2307-11658.creator: Antoine Henrot, Raphaël Gastaldello, Ilaria Lucardesi
arxiv-2307-11658.description: Abstract . We study the Blaschke-Santaló diagram associated to the area, the perimeter, and the moment of inertia. We work in dimension 2, under two assumptions on the shapes: convexity and the presence of two orthogonal axis of symmetry. We discuss topological and geometrical properties of the diagram.

arxiv-2311-13406.title: Zig-zag dynamics in a Stern-Gerlach spin measurement
arxiv-2311-13406.creator: Simon Krekels, Christian Maes, Kasper Meerts, Ward Struyve
arxiv-2311-13406.description: Abstract The one-century-old Stern-Gerlach setup is paradigmatic for a quantum measurement. We visualize the electron trajectories following the Bohmian zig-zag dynamics. This dynamics was developed in order to deal with the fundamentally massless nature of particles (with mass emerging from the Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism).

arxiv-2509-25640.title: Analysis of a Spatialized Brain-Body-Environment System
arxiv-2509-25640.creator: Denizhan Pak, Quan Le Thien, Christopher J. Agostino
arxiv-2509-25640.description: Abstract The brain-body-environment framework studies adaptive behavior through embodied and situated agents, emphasizing interactions between brains, biomechanics, and environmental dynamics. However, many models often treat the brain as a network of coupled ordinary differential equations (ODEs), neglecting finer spatial properties which can not only increase model complexity but also constrain observable neural dynamics.

arxiv-2512-13645.title: Linear Regression in a Nonlinear World
arxiv-2512-13645.creator: Nadav Kunievsky
arxiv-2512-13645.description: Abstract The interpretation of coefficients from multivariate linear regression relies on the assumption that the conditional expectation function is linear in the variables. However, in many cases the underlying data generating process is nonlinear. This paper examines how to interpret regression coefficients under nonlinearity.

arxiv-2601-04026.title: Transport properties in a model of confined granular mixtures at moderate densities
arxiv-2601-04026.creator: David González Méndez, Vicente Garzó
arxiv-2601-04026.description: Abstract This work derives the Navier–Stokes hydrodynamic equations for a model of a confined, quasi-two-dimensional, s s -component mixture of inelastic, smooth, hard spheres. Using the inelastic version of the revised Enskog theory, macroscopic balance equations for mass, momentum, and energy are obtained, and constitutive equations for the fluxes are determined through a first-order Chapman–Enskog expansion.

pmc-10575530.title: Gcn4 impacts metabolic fluxes to promote yeast chronological lifespan
pmc-10575530.creator: Juan Facundo Gulias, Florencia Niesi, Martín Arán, Susana Correa-García, Mariana Bermúdez-Moretti
pmc-10575530.description: Aging is characterized by a gradual decline in physiological integrity, which impairs functionality and increases susceptibility to mortality. Dietary restriction, mimicking nutrient scarcity without causing malnutrition, is an intervention known to decelerate the aging process. While various hypotheses have been proposed to elucidate how dietary restriction influences aging, the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood.

pmc-10671849.title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Marine-Inspired Compounds Result in Hybrids with Antitrypanosomal and Antileishmanial Activities
pmc-10671849.creator: Diogo Teixeira Carvalho, Melissa Teixeira, Sara Luelmo, Nuno Santarém, Eugénia Pinto, Anabela Cordeiro-da-Silva, Emília Sousa
pmc-10671849.description: Natural products are a very rich source for obtaining new compounds with therapeutic potential. In the search for new antiparasitic and antimicrobial agents, molecular hybrids were designed based on the structures of antimicrobial marine quinazolinones and eugenol, a natural phenolic compound.

pmc-11674656.title: The VEGFA rs2010963 Gene Polymorphism Is a Potential Genetic Risk Factor for Myocardial Infarction in Slovenian Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-11674656.creator: Emin Grbić, Jernej Letonja, Danijel Petrovič
pmc-11674656.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Coronary artery disease (CAD) is a life-threatening condition caused by the chronic gradual narrowing of the lumen of the blood vessels of the heart by atherosclerotic plaque with a strong genetic component. The aim of our study was to investigate the association between the VEGFA polymorphism rs2010963 and myocardial infarction in patients with type 2 diabetes, as well as the expression of VEGFA.

pmc-11739036.title: Prevalence and Interrelation of Irritable Bowel Syndrome With Generalized Anxiety Disorder Among Sudanese Medical Students, 2020
pmc-11739036.creator: Samah H Heamid, Danya Ibrahim
pmc-11739036.description: AimsThis study aimed to determine the prevalence of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) among medical students at Khartoum University and to examine its association with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD).MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted between December 2020 and February 2021, using the Rome IV criteria to diagnose IBS and a 7-item generalized anxiety disorder (GAD-7) scale to assess GAD.

pmc-12472934.title: Analysis of Genomic and Characterization Features of Microbulbifer weihaiensis sp. nov., Isolated from Coastal Sediment
pmc-12472934.creator: Yu-Xuan Zhang, Ai-Qiu Liu, Alexander Machado Cardoso
pmc-12472934.description: A strictly aerobic, straight-rod, motile Gram-negative bacterium, SDUM041083T, was isolated from marine sediment in Xiaoshidao, Weihai, China, in the formation of yellowish-brown colonies. Its growing conditions are as follows: 20–40 °C, pH 5.5–9.5, and 0.5–11% (w/v) NaCl. Phylogenetic analysis of the 16S rRNA gene sequence showed that SDUM041083T was related to members of the genus Microbulbifer.

pmc-13252694.title: Perioperative psycho-oncological intervention is associated with reduced psychological distress in women with breast and gynecological cancers: a prospective study
pmc-13252694.creator: Mădălina Daniela Meoded, Mariana Tănase, Claudia Mehedințu, Ciprian Cirimbei
pmc-13252694.description: Psychological distress is highly prevalent among patients with cancer, particularly during the perioperative period. Psycho-oncological interventions may improve emotional outcomes, yet their short-term effectiveness and moderating factors remain insufficiently explored. This prospective pre–post observational study without a control group included 95 women diagnosed with breast and gynecological cancers.

pmc-13649548.title: A single centre retrospective study of the long‑term weight and pregnancy-related outcomes in women of reproductive age before and after liraglutide exposure
pmc-13649548.creator: Tariq Chukir, Hubaib Haider, Shaunak Sarkar, Siddhant Nair, Rami Kokash, Odette Chagoury, Shahrad Taheri
pmc-13649548.description: BackgroundThe impact of GLP‑1 receptor agonist exposure prior to pregnancy on pregnancy-related outcomes remains unclear, with studies reporting mixed findings.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study evaluating bodyweight and pregnancy-related outcomes among women of reproductive age who were initiated on liraglutide for obesity management and had 2–5 years of follow-up.

(a) Asylum applicants (1) In general In addition to any other fee authorized by law, the Secretary of Homeland Security shall require the payment of a fee, equal to the amount specified in this subsection, by any alien who files an initial application for employment.
